column1: # SEARCH-ML compound libraries for forward screening.
# Columns (tab-separated): key  aliases  label  path  size
#   path : directory or CSV file, relative to the datasets folder ($SEARCHML_DATASETS,
#          default $SEARCH_ML_HOME/datasets) or absolute. A directory may hold
#          dataset.csv(.gz) or a parts/ folder of CSV chunks; count.txt (row count) is optional.
#   size : small | large  (large libraries run with parallel workers and a top-N limit)
# The numeric aliases 1-8 match the database IDs used by the original web portal.
